what: A Lowrey home-organ firmware: three organ banks, a wavetable bank and a Pocket Piano bank, plus a rhythm unit with built-in beats, a Volca-style drum sequencer and an automatic bass. Note sequencer, MIDI in and out, and USB audio with an organ/drums split.
sounds: licensed: Mellotron M400S flute tapes recorded by Taijiguy (Bernie Kornowicz), free to use in non-commercial software
